title: Wardens team (.claude/wardens.yaml)
description: The whole warden team in one file: who owns which paths, what each warden may run, and team-wide settings. Agent prompts live in .claude/agents/<name>.md.

mode.description: enforce: deny out-of-authority tool calls and invalid briefs/reports. warn: record them in the ledger only (use for the first week to size authorities).

confidence-floor.description: An UpwardReport claiming at least this confidence must list `verification` (commands run + result).

ledger.description: Where the hooks append the outcome ledger. Keep it under the gitignored .wardens/ directory.

agent-dirs.description: Directories holding agent files. The plugin's bundled agents are always available.

ownership-file.description: An existing path→owner map, JSON `[{glob, owner}]` or `{entries: [...]}`. Each warden's authority becomes its `owns` plus every glob assigned to it here. `owner: null` rows mean unowned.

never-run.description: Commands no warden may run, added to the built-ins (git commit, git push, git tag, git rebase, git reset --hard, npm/pnpm/yarn/bun publish). Applies whatever a warden's `run` says.

always-run.description: Read-only commands every warden may run, added to the built-ins (cd, pwd, ls, cat, head, tail, wc, grep, rg, echo, git status/diff/log/show/ls-files/blame).

wardens.description: The team. Each key is a warden name and must match an agent file's `name` (.claude/agents/<name>.md).

oneOf.description: Declared with no settings: inherits the bundled defaults (debrief-scribe, evidence-warden).

kind.description: domain: owns code and fixes it. specialist: writes only its own reports (reviews, audits, evidence) and routes findings to domain wardens.

owns.description: Globs this warden may edit (Edit/Write/redirects). Enforced. Quote globs that start with `*`, e.g. "**/*.sql".

run.description: Commands this warden may run, matched by prefix per shell segment (`pytest services/api` also allows `pytest services/api/test_x.py -q`). Omit to guard only never-run commands and redirects; ["*"] allows anything not in never-run.

expires.description: Pilot window end date. `warden doctor` fails after it until the warden is ratified (remove `expires`) or removed.
